blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Letran survived a desperate San Sebastian, 91-89, with Jimboy Estrada hitting the game-winner on Friday in NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament action at San Juan Arena. With the score tied at 89, the Knights had 6.3 seconds to work with and put their trust in Estrada, who nailed a step-back midrange jumper with six-tenths of a second to go. “My confidence in him is very high because I know what his character is,” Letran coach Allen Ricardo said in Filipino. “As a coach, I need to maximize his full potential on how he can make those types of decisions.” […]...
